pro_course_detail.title: German - - -  Conversation Practise / Casual lessons
pro_course_detail.description:
These are casual conversation-based lessons without a set structure: We can talk about everyday situations, practise a few common situations (ordering coffee, reserving a hotel room or some simple small talk) or practise specific skills (making a telephone call, writing basic emails). I'll give you everything you need to get started for these conversation-based lessons: new vocabulary to learn, useful phrases for everyday situations, and expert tips for memorization. 

We can base our lessons on your current study plan, to include language learning apps like Duolingo, Babbel or Anki, use any course books you are currently using and also include things like podcasts and YouTube videos. No problem if you don't have any study material yet - I can provide this to you for free. Learning a language from a basic level involves having many different options and I will help you find your perfect learning style, and I can also show you all the best methods and tricks to get there quickly - and we'll have a lot fun along the way!

pro_course_detail.title: German - - - Accent Reduction Program (ARP) **NEW**
pro_course_detail.description:
Sound like a native speaker! I can teach you very specific pronunciation techniques used by actors, singers and business professionals. My Accent Reduction Program will help you communicate more clearly and confidently. I will give you the tools and expertise to develop a perfect accent. I'll teach you how to move your mouth, make new sounds and sound like a native speaker. We'll use the IPA (International Phonetic Alphabet) and a chart that shows the different sounds. We can use MP3 files, Anki or any other audio tools to help you train your listening and speaking skills, I'll show you how to imitate any speaking style, and radically change how you sound. The standard German accent is called "Hochdeutsch" and I am a native speaker, if you need a different, regional accent such as Austrian or Swiss, I can do this too, no problem.

I'll encourage you to set up a daily routine to practise your material and we'll measure your progress throughout the course. Student typically book a course of ten lessons to complete the whole Accent Reduction Program, and you will need to be able to practise at least 15 minutes a day for the training to be effective. If you want to, you could provide me with a few recordings of your current accent for me to study and analyze, and also some details about which languages your speak, specifics about your particular region or dialect and anything else that might help me put together the best training package for you.

role-play workplace conversations.

pro_course_detail.description:
Example: Speaking Test

The IELTS speaking test will assess your use of spoken English. The test will last between 11 and 14 minutes where you will discuss a variety of topics with an IELTS examiner.  

There are 3 parts to the speaking test.  

Part 1  
The examiner will ask you general questions about yourself and a range of familiar topics, such as home, family, work, studies and interests. This part lasts between 4 and 5 minutes.  

Part 2  
You will be given a task card and the examiner will ask you to talk about a topic. You will have 1 minute to prepare before speaking for up to 2 minutes. The examiner will then ask one or two questions on the same topic to finish this part of the test.  

Part 3
You will be asked further questions connected to the topic in Part 2. These questions will allow you to discuss more abstract ideas and issues. This part of the test lasts between 4 and 5 minutes.

pro_course_detail.description:
I have an intensive program in teaching Arabic for advanced Arabic student, 
I am teaching the conversation for non-Arabic speakers from all over the world on the Internet on several sites and centers.
Speaking: Acquired vocabulary and grammar skills are useless if the language learner cannot verbally produce fluent language. For this reason, my courses emphasized the development of oral fluency above all other key language skills. Through a communicative and student centered approach, our instructors give students as many opportunities to practice speech as possible. my content-based learning immersion activities (like cooking club and calligraphy) give students even more contact time with the Arabic language.

Listening: The primary objective of our Arabic instructors as they speak in class is to model native speech and pronounciation. In practice an immersion curriculum does not rely heavily on grammar drills or assignments in translation. At the beginning level of our Arabic classes, i spoke as little English as possible (less than 5%). From the intermediate level onward English will not be spoken at all.

Reading/Writing: Another key skill area, literacy. In order to foster development in reading and writing in Arabic, our instructors insure that the content they are using has connection to students' interests and that it resonates with them. Many times the difference between success and failure in a classroom is engagement. At Qalam wa Lawh we strive to ensure that all of the material in our classrooms is worth reading.

Presentational Skills: Presenting information clearly and effectively is another vital communication skill. Today, presentational skills are required in almost every field. For this reason, all students at Qalam wa Lawh are prepared for and expected to present in Arabic for 5 minutes and participate in a short Q&A with their peers at the completion of their course.

What makes me stand out is that I have learned how the CIA and FBI teach languages. It is quick, effective, easy and it works like no other system. And now I can help you reach more proficiency effectively so that you learn German with joy and confidence.

I provide a safe space full of encouragement and positivity. My students often comment on my patience and clarity.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
My teaching centers around the system in use by the CIA and FBI. The key to learning a language quickly is to apply interval recall of vocabulary while forming sentences. 

This way of learning makes the learner produce the words instantly out of his or her own mind (as opposed to a book or another outside source) therefore creating the new neural pathways.

We can work at a quick pace because the more sentences you produce the better you will retain the new information.

I also use pictures to create a simple prompt and response conversation style which enables even beginning students to talk in the target language.
